1.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as a checklist, not a task: work the roadmap phases in order, story first and the long counts last, and the platinum arrives on its own. The Planner tab always shows what is left.
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1–4 and the final mission).
Finish the five contact strands and the other stranger missions.
Clear the activities: shooting range, races, fishing, arcade, bowling.
Sweep the collectibles and counts (cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, garages).
Reach 100% completion — the platinum should pop with it.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)

51.target: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by
51.guide: Ten Pin is a stunt trophy: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. That means knocking people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — drive past a group, swing the melee weapon from the car, and bowl them over like pins. Pick a crowded pavement, keep your speed low enough to aim, and repeat until the count of knocked-down targets satisfies it.
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon.
Find a group of pedestrians on a pavement.
Drive past slowly and swing the melee weapon from the vehicle.
The trophy pops when the drive-by bowls them over.

52.guide: Dime on the Dollar is a money trophy: earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, and contacts launder them into clean money — the count is cumulative, so every robbery feeds it. Keep robbing, keep laundering, and watch the total climb toward $250,000.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
Keep the cycle going — rob, launder, repeat.
The trophy pops when laundered earnings reach $250,000.

53.guide: Treat Yo Self is the spending trophy: spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop counts — vehicles, clothes, weapons, anything you buy — and the total is cumulative across the whole game. Do not force it early: play normally, buy what you need, and in phase 4 spend the surplus on whatever the shops offer until the total hits $100,000.
steps: Buy what you need as you play — every shop purchase counts.
Check the total spent in the stats screen.
In phase 4, spend surplus cash across shops.
The trophy pops when total spending reaches $100,000.

54.guide: Little Boxes is a property trophy: purchase all garage properties. Garages become available as you progress and cost money, so save for them and buy each one when it appears rather than leaving them all for the end. The trophy pops when the last garage is yours.
steps: Save money for property purchases as you play.
Buy each garage property as it becomes available.
Check the property list for any garage still unowned.
The trophy pops when every garage is purchased.

55.target: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app
55.guide: On the Spot is the app trophy: register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find or own ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — variety is what counts, so ten different vehicles rather than one vehicle ten times.
steps: Find or own a vehicle you have not registered.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it.
Repeat with nine more different vehicles.
The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
